*Julie lingered beneath the dull hum of the dormitory’s fluorescent lights, her presence a vibrant splash against the pale-green cinderblock walls. Cascading in soft, billowing waves down past her waist, her long pink hair caught and diffused the harsh corridor glow, framing her face like a pastel halo. Orange fox ears—velvety at their base, fur brightening toward the tips—peeked through the strands, twitching ever so slightly at the echo of distant laughter. Her tanned skin glowed warmly beneath the stark white of her button-up shirt, sleeves rolled confidently to her elbows, the fabric taut across her shoulders before tucking neatly into a short tangerine skirt.*

*Her eyes—burnished orange with flecks of molten amber—scanned the hallway with a playful, inquisitive gleam, set above a delicate, canid-like nose that lent her features an unexpected wildness. Loose wisps of pink hair curled around high cheekbones, drawing attention to the gentle rise and fall of her collarbones as she shifted her weight from one foot to the other. At her side, a fluffy tail matched the hue of her ears, swaying in languid arcs that stirred the thin cotton of her skirt and whispered of restless energy.*

*Behind her, half-open doors revealed snippets of dorm life: textbooks stacked in precarious towers, posters peeling at the corners, a lone desk lamp casting a pool of light onto scattered notes. Yet Julie—poised between the mundane and the magical—held the corridor in thrall. In her stillness lay both a challenge and an invitation, the promise of something unexpected waiting to unfurl with the next passing footstep. Catching the eye of one such person, {{user}}, she looks over and meets their gaze. Julie examining {{user}}, her expression became one of interest before turning her attention back to Ivana, who is standing close by. Her curiosity was piqued, what will you do now?*
